purpose.statement: Define ArchitectureDesign 0.1.0 as one deterministic DevRelay module that converts an approved RequirementsBaseline into either a new architecture baseline candidate or a proposed change to an existing architecture, using a configured chain of bounded, replaceable adapters.

businessObjectives.statement: Make architecture workflow selection and execution deterministic and replayable.
Allow bounded best-in-class architecture capabilities to be replaced independently.
Produce traceable architecture candidates ready for separate approval.

users.name: Workflow author
users.description: A maintainer or integrator configuring DevRelay architecture workflows.
needs: Design a change against an approved architecture baseline.
Establish a new architecture baseline candidate.
Inspect exact evidence and gate readiness.

keyCapabilities.description: Execute designer, modeler, and decision-recorder handoffs in order.

scope.statement: One ArchitectureDesign module with establish-baseline and design-change operations.
Deterministic operation routing from persisted project architecture state.
A prerequisite ArchitectureDiscovery route for existing repositories without a current architecture snapshot.
Ordered designer, modeler, and decision-recorder adapter steps.
Step handoffs, clarification checkpoints, native-source preservation, validation, conformance fixtures, and documentation.
V1 adapter manifests for Spec Kit plan, OpenSpec design, Structurizr, and MADR.

constraints.statement: ArchitectureDesign must consume an approved RequirementsBaseline.
constraints.rationale: Architecture work must start from approved requirements.

constraints.statement: Each adapter manifest must bind only the relevant upstream capability for its declared ArchitectureDesign step; DevRelay must not treat an upstream repository's full workflow as one module.
constraints.rationale: Bounded capabilities preserve module ownership and permit independent best-in-class replacement.

constraints.statement: ArchitectureDesign produces candidates only; it cannot approve or promote its own result.
constraints.rationale: Approval belongs to the separate Architecture Gate.

constraints.statement: DevRelay Core, not a model or adapter, selects the operation, configured adapters, sequence, validation path, and gate progression.
constraints.rationale: DevRelay Core retains deterministic workflow authority.

constraints.statement: Every runtime boundary uses immutable artifact references and exact adapter versions.
constraints.rationale: Replay and verification require immutable boundaries.

constraints.statement: ArchitectureDesign must capture interface intent and architectural constraints, while detailed API, event, data, and protocol contracts remain in downstream ContractGeneration.
constraints.rationale: Architecture should define boundaries without collapsing a later deterministic lifecycle stage.

constraints.statement: Module contracts remain provider-neutral and cannot branch on adapter or upstream-tool identifiers in generic core.
constraints.rationale: The kernel must remain independently extensible.

constraints.statement: The implementation must preserve compatibility with RequirementsGathering 0.1.0.
constraints.rationale: The new module must compose with the released requirements boundary.

constraints.statement: The first pass must remain small enough to prove modular composition without creating a general workflow platform.
constraints.rationale: The proof must not become a general workflow platform.

constraints.statement: The V1 default chain must use SpecKitPlanAdapter for establish-baseline or OpenSpecDesignAdapter for design-change, followed by StructurizrAdapter and MADRAdapter.
constraints.rationale: These are selected V1 implementations of stable semantic step contracts, not hard-coded kernel behavior.

nonFunctionalRequirements.statement: The implementation must include positive and negative schema, routing, registry, chain, artifact, clarification, provenance, backward-compatibility, and core-neutrality tests.
nonFunctionalRequirements.measure: Required schema, routing, chain, artifact, clarification, provenance, compatibility, and neutrality checks passing.

nonFunctionalRequirements.statement: Every step handoff and primary output must preserve exact input, adapter, native-source, normalization, and output provenance without relying on conversational or provider session memory.
nonFunctionalRequirements.measure: Percentage of step handoffs and primary outputs with complete exact provenance.
